description: Complete one-player game from power-on (ticket #137, F65): prefix-equal to sf-win-10 through frame 43618 (power-on reset, warning, attract, coin1 at 1500, start1 at 1620, country select Japan, all 10 opponents Retsu, Geki, Joe, Mike, Lee, Gen, Birdie, Eagle, Adon, and Sagat, all 4 bonus stages, and the complete ending 0x44a40..0x44c1c into 0x3efc4 / 0x3f2d0 / 0x42422 name entry at 43617..43618), then three p1_lp presses (43630, 43655, 43680) that enter initials AAA into rank 1 (605,700 pts) at 0x425c4, run the 3-second marked-entry ranking blink (0x42750..0x427e0), run the 240-frame game-over screen (0x3f2e0 -> 0x3f2f0..0x3f33a), and return to the attract loop (0x3f33c -> 0x3ccae -> 0x3ccc2 -> 0x3ccec) through frame 44199.

reference.notes: US set 1, six-button controls; MAME set sf. ROM set verified by mame -verifyroms against the pinned build.

machine.dipswitches: factory defaults; observed readback DSW1=0xdfff, DSW2=0xffff

inputs.comment: insert coin; title screen is up from ~1375
confirm default country Japan at country select (visible by ~1860)
bonus-1 plank break press (power 10, success branch 0x410b6-0x41220)
bonus-2 stone break press (power 10, success branch 0x41d8c-0x41eda)
name entry: commit first initial A (0x427e2 -> 0x42920)
name entry: commit second initial A (0x427e2 -> 0x42920)
name entry: commit third initial A and finish name entry (0x42920 -> 0x425c4)
